title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten no-admission activities at Smith and nearby Northampton, each supported by a direct public-access or free-admission source.

cards.title: Wander the Lyman Plant House
cards.subtitle: Botanic Garden of Smith College
cards.notes: Walk the conservatory’s plant collections at your own pace, then use the garden’s visit page to confirm the day’s access before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A free indoor plant stop on the Smith campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith’s Botanic Garden says it is free and open to the public year-round and lists the Lyman Plant House & Conservatory among its visitable collections.
cards.source_title: Visit the Botanic Garden of Smith College
cards.access_notes: Listed daily 9 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed during the college winter break and on listed holiday closures. Check the official page for changes.

cards.title: Take an arboretum walk
cards.subtitle: Botanic Garden of Smith College
cards.notes: Choose a short loop through the campus trees and pause to look closely at seasonal changes; it works well as a low-key walk with a friend.
cards.short_summary: A free, year-round walk through Smith’s tree collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith’s Botanic Garden states that visitors can explore its 127-acre arboretum and that the garden is free and open to the public year-round.
cards.source_title: Visit the Botanic Garden of Smith College
cards.access_notes: The official visit page lists the Campus Arboretum and Gardens as open daily to the public year-round.

cards.title: Sit by Capen Garden’s fountain
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Gardens, Botanic Garden of Smith College
cards.notes: Use the fountain and perennial border as a conversation stop, then take a slow lap around the rose arbor and surrounding beds.
cards.short_summary: A fountain-centered outdoor garden on the Smith campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith identifies Capen Garden as an outdoor garden with a small fountain, perennial border, rose arbor, gazebo, and surrounding beds; the Botanic Garden is free and open to the public year-round.
cards.source_title: Outdoor Gardens: Capen, Happy Chace, Systematics, Rock, Perennial Border, Wilson Bulb Bank, Trudy's
cards.access_notes: Outdoor gardens are part of Smith’s Botanic Garden; its official visit page says the garden is free and open to the public year-round.

cards.title: Follow the paths at Happy Chace
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Gardens, Botanic Garden of Smith College
cards.notes: Meet behind the President’s House and follow the fragrant paths to the open-air pavilion, taking in the view toward Paradise Pond and the Mill River.
cards.short_summary: A terraced garden overlooking Paradise Pond.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith describes the Happy Chace 1928 Garden as a terraced garden behind the President’s House with fragrant pathways, an open-air pavilion, and views of Paradise Pond and the Mill River.
cards.source_title: Outdoor Gardens: Capen, Happy Chace, Systematics, Rock, Perennial Border, Wilson Bulb Bank, Trudy's
cards.access_notes: Outdoor gardens are within the Botanic Garden, which Smith says is free and open to the public year-round.

cards.title: Take the Japanese Garden path
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Gardens, Botanic Garden of Smith College
cards.notes: Walk the wooded hillside route beside Paradise Pond, moving slowly enough to notice how the garden’s features sit within the New England landscape.
cards.short_summary: A wooded hillside garden beside Paradise Pond.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith says the Japanese Garden is on the wooded hillside beside Paradise Pond and was built to demonstrate harmony with nature and offer space for contemplation and reflection.
cards.source_title: Outdoor Gardens: Capen, Happy Chace, Systematics, Rock, Perennial Border, Wilson Bulb Bank, Trudy's
cards.access_notes: Outdoor gardens are within the Botanic Garden, which Smith says is free and open to the public year-round.

cards.title: Compare blooms in the Systematics Garden
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Gardens, Botanic Garden of Smith College
cards.notes: Bring a friend and compare flower shapes across the beds; the planting arrangement is designed around evolutionary relationships among the species.
cards.short_summary: A garden arranged to show relationships among flowering plants.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith says the Systematics Garden arranges diverse flowering species in beds that reflect current scientific understanding of their evolutionary relationships.
cards.source_title: Outdoor Gardens: Capen, Happy Chace, Systematics, Rock, Perennial Border, Wilson Bulb Bank, Trudy's
cards.access_notes: Outdoor gardens are within the Botanic Garden, which Smith says is free and open to the public year-round.

cards.title: Browse the SCMA galleries
cards.subtitle: 20 Elm Street, Smith College
cards.notes: Pick one floor or exhibition to explore together, then pause with a single work and trade observations before moving on through the galleries.
cards.short_summary: Free public access to Smith’s art museum galleries.
cards.evidence_claim: The Smith College Museum of Art states that it is free and open to all.
cards.source_title: Accessing the Collection | Smith College Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: The museum says its galleries are closed to the public on Mondays; check the museum’s visit information before going.

cards.title: Catch a Music Department performance
cards.subtitle: Smith College performing-arts venues
cards.notes: Check the department calendar, choose a program that fits your evening, and arrive a little early to settle in before the performance begins.
cards.short_summary: Public Smith music events require neither admission nor reservation.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith College states that all Music Department events are free and open to the public, with no tickets or reservations required.
cards.source_title: Attend an Event for Smith College Performing Arts
cards.access_notes: Confirm the event date, venue, and program on Smith’s calendar. The page notes that Valley Classical Concert series events are an exception and require tickets.

cards.title: Meet on the Hess Stage lawn
cards.subtitle: Forbes Library, 20 West Street, Northampton
cards.notes: Bring a conversation or a book and use the open lawn around the stage as a daylight meet-up; leave the space ready for the next visitors.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor gathering spot at Northampton’s public library.
cards.evidence_claim: Forbes Library states that the Hess Performance Stage and library grounds are free and open to the public during daylight hours when not in use by library programming.
cards.source_title: Grand Opening of New Stage – Forbes Library
cards.access_notes: Free public access is during daylight hours when the stage and grounds are not being used by library programming.

cards.entity_name: Forbes Library Neighborhood Free Book Boxes
cards.title: Choose a free book to keep
cards.subtitle: Northampton, Florence, and Leeds locations
cards.notes: Find a box on your route, browse the replenished selection, and take a book that catches your attention for a no-cost reading break.
cards.short_summary: Library-supported neighborhood boxes stocked with free books.
cards.evidence_claim: Forbes Library says its Neighborhood Free Book Boxes give children, teens, and adults access to free books and are replenished weekly by staff and volunteers.
cards.source_title: Neighborhood Free Book Boxes – Forbes Library
cards.access_notes: Boxes are located throughout Northampton, Leeds, and Florence; use the library’s information to identify a convenient box.
